01.description: A lightweight CI/CD library designed for small teams who want automated deployments without the overhead of full-scale DevOps tools. TinyOps handles build pipelines, test automation, and zero-downtime deployments with a minimal configuration surface.
challenges: Designing a pluggable pipeline system that works with any Node project
Keeping the binary under 5MB while supporting multiple providers
Writing idempotent deployment scripts that handle rollbacks gracefully
features: Built-in support for Docker, Vercel, and bare-metal deploys

02.description: A contract management platform that streamlines the entire agreement lifecycle — from drafting and negotiation to signing and renewals. Built for legal teams who need clarity, not complexity.
challenges: Building a real-time collaborative editor with version history
Implementing role-based access control across organizations
features: Full audit trail with timestamped changes

03.description: An intelligent color palette generator that uses color theory algorithms to create harmonious palettes from any input image or hex code. Qolors helps designers explore color relationships with real-time preview.
challenges: Implementing accurate color space conversions (RGB ↔ HSLuv ↔ LAB)
Building a WebGL shader that visualizes palettes in 3D space
Optimizing real-time palette generation for large images
features: Export palettes to CSS, Tailwind, Figma, and Adobe Swatch

04.description: A documentation platform that turns Markdown into beautiful, searchable documentation sites. Focused on developer experience with instant search, versioned docs, and a powerful theming system.
challenges: Building a custom MDX parser with enhanced component support
Implementing versioned documentation without duplicating content
Designing a theming system that allows full visual customization
features: Custom MDX components (tabs, diagrams, API tables)
Dark mode with system preference detection
